rationale: Tiny-SD is the reproducible control floor but its latent UNet is not the long-term HSME dense DiT core.
SANA-Sprint proves strong few-step DiT quality but its required Gemma2-2B text conditioner alone exceeds the HSME initial useful-pack envelope.
SnapGen++ and MobileDiffusion provide strong mobile architecture evidence but no reviewed pinnable commercial checkpoint is available to this decision slice.
The highest-quality path is a BERS-owned compact dense DiT student distilled from separately admitted teacher/reference models, measured against Tiny-SD on identical product evidence.

reasons: Existing BERS trust root pins twelve runtime files and exact upstream revision.
Runtime snapshot is 1062108664 bytes, close enough to serve as the current storage/control floor.
CreativeML OpenRAIL-M is reviewed with use and redistribution obligations but production approval is not granted.
UNet architecture is useful as a control but does not satisfy the selected long-term compact dense DiT direction.
The official model is a 0.6B linear diffusion transformer with unified one-to-four-step generation.
The official diffusers pipeline requires Gemma2-2B-IT as its text encoder.
The text encoder index reports 5228683776 bytes, over five times the complete HSME initial useful-pack ceiling before denoiser and VAE bytes.
The model is Apache-2.0 but the mandatory Gemma component carries separate Gemma terms, so the complete pipeline has mixed license obligations.
Use as few-step distillation and DiT architecture reference, not as the direct mobile runtime baseline.

sources.license: Apache-2.0 plus Gemma terms for Gemma2-2B-IT

reasons: SnapGen++ is explicitly designed for mobile and edge DiT execution with adaptive global-local sparse attention.
The paper reports a small approximately 0.4B four-step variant and on-device deployment evidence.
No reviewed immutable public checkpoint and commercial redistribution trust root is pinned in BERS for this model.
Adopt architectural and distillation ideas only until independently reproducible weights and license evidence exist.
Google reports a 520M mobile latent-diffusion design with one-step DiffusionGAN sampling.
The published mobile evidence demonstrates sub-second 512x512 generation on premium iOS and Android devices.
The research publication does not provide the immutable commercially reviewed model trust root required by HSME-2.
Use as mobile macro-architecture and hardware-efficiency reference rather than a baseline identity.
Allows the complete runtime footprint rather than denoiser parameter count to be optimized for the HSME mobile envelope.
Allows a compact text-conditioning path to be selected and licensed independently instead of inheriting a multi-gigabyte text encoder.
Preserves the canonical dense shared fallback required before Adapter-MoE specialization.
Can combine mobile-first architecture, few-step distillation and later hardware-specific representations without inheriting another project's runtime authority.
